d: Lok aastha aur sury upasna ke mahaparv chhath ke tisre din aaj rajyabhar men shraddha aur bhakti ka mahaul raha. chhath vratiyon ne vibhinn nadiyon, talabon aur jalashyon ke ghaton par astachalgami sury dev ko pahla arghy arpit kiya. chhath giton aur paranprik lokdhunon se pura vatavran bhaktimay bana raha. char divsiy mahaparv ke antim din kal subah udiyman sury ko dusra arghy arpit kiya jaega, jiske sath hi chhath puja ka samapan hoga. vahin, janjatiy gaurav divas ke avsar par pradhanmantri narendr modi ne janjatiy kshetron ke samagr vikas aur janjatiy samudayon ko vikas ki mukhyadhara…
